recognize_zh: 上排為發炎性巨噬細胞：細胞大、核圓或腎形、細胞質豐富且布滿小空泡並成群聚集；下排為印戒樣巨噬細胞：細胞質被一個大空泡填滿，把核壓扁推到一側呈新月形，形似印戒。
features: Panel A: large macrophages with round to kidney-shaped nuclei and moderately dispersed chromatin
Panel A: abundant basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles, singly and in cohesive-appearing clusters
Panel B: macrophages with a single large clear cytoplasmic vacuole containing faint foamy material
Panel B: nucleus compressed into a crescent at the cell periphery (signet-ring appearance), with condensed chromatin
Background of small lymphocytes, red cells and occasional neutrophils
describe_en: Cytospin preparation of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid shows numerous macrophages. Panel A shows inflammatory (activated) macrophages with round to reniform nuclei and abundant finely vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm, occurring singly and in clusters. Panel B shows macrophages in which a single large cytoplasmic vacuole displaces and compresses the nucleus into a crescent, producing a signet-ring appearance; the nuclei are bland without atypia. Small lymphocytes and red cells are present in the background. Findings are consistent with reactive alveolar macrophages, including signet-ring forms, in the setting of active pulmonary tuberculosis; these should not be mistaken for signet-ring carcinoma cells.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells show nuclear atypia, hyperchromasia, prominent nucleoli and cohesive three-dimensional clusters, with mucin and cytokeratin positivity.
Mesothelial cells have dense central cytoplasm with a peripheral pale rim, windows between cells and are calretinin-positive, and are not expected in BAL.
Reactive pneumocytes form cohesive clusters with larger nucleoli and are TTF-1/cytokeratin positive, CD68-negative.
Lipid-laden macrophages have multiple small fat vacuoles that stain with Oil Red O, rather than a single large vacuole, and correlate with aspiration.
